% A revtex4 letter for prl, which numbers no section, with a single
% appendix from \appendix*. It checks a case the fix must not break: the
% heading has no number and no "Appendix:", as in the PDF.
\documentclass[prl]{revtex4}
\begin{document}
\title{Revfour letter appendix}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\appendix*
\section{Methods}
Text of the methods.
\end{document}
